required_capability: Extract outcome intent, entities, metric/unit, time basis, horizon, grain, scope, filters and requested action from unseen language.
contract_or_output: Versioned intent draft; preserve original request, ambiguity and unfilled fields
guardrail: No anticipated-question list; resolve only material missing details.

required_capability: Discover current schemas, types, grains, time/identifier/measure profiles, lineage, rights and approved relationships.
contract_or_output: Versioned evidence catalogue with actual source/column bindings and validity times
guardrail: Column-name resemblance is insufficient; new data triggers re-profiling and review.

required_capability: Bind requested meaning to supported fields and business definitions with traceable alternatives.
contract_or_output: Proposed semantic bindings, evidence and minimal clarification request
guardrail: No invented columns/outcomes or silent metric substitution.

required_capability: Specify outcome equation, entity/record grain, eligible population, event/availability clocks, H, label window/maturity, units/sign/currency, authority and permitted joins.
contract_or_output: Human-reviewable versioned target contract independent of wording
guardrail: Business-rule configurations are reusable semantic metadata, not question-to-model mappings.

required_capability: Check source authenticity, complete periods, temporal integrity, support, labels/cohorts, identifiers, leakage and join conservation.
contract_or_output: Admissible / conditional / unsupported decision with blockers and required evidence
guardrail: Unsupported or ambiguous requests yield limitations or necessary questions, never fabricated values/confidence.

required_capability: Separate retrieval/SQL/rules, numerical forecasting, unknown-outcome regression, classification and other supported tasks.
contract_or_output: Admissible strategy families and resource/business constraints
guardrail: No single algorithm and no fixed question/model table; candidate suitability must follow the approved contract.

required_capability: Honor the target contract with versioned, reusable preparation and point-in-time transformation components.
contract_or_output: Lineage-preserving execution plan and fitted-transform boundaries
guardrail: Not implemented or executed in this assessment; raw evidence stays immutable.

component: Evaluation and candidate comparison — future only
required_capability: Select time-respecting folds, baselines, appropriate error metrics/decision utility, calibration and interval diagnostics when relevant.
contract_or_output: Auditable evaluation protocol and measured evidence before selection
guardrail: No made-up performance; fit transforms only within training folds; protect final holdout.

required_capability: Apply approved fitted artifacts to an authorized request and supported horizon/entity scope.
contract_or_output: Prediction versus observed fact, units, as-of time, empirical uncertainty, lineage and limitations
guardrail: Block extrapolation beyond evaluated scope and unknown entities without an approved policy.

required_capability: Track freshness, schema/identity/semantic drift, target/availability changes, evaluation decay and access policy.
contract_or_output: Registries of evidence/semantic contracts/components and monitored versions
guardrail: New domains extend metadata/adapters/contracts; no rewrite of core or exhaustive question catalogue required.
